title: Saros Mod Checker
description: A server-side mod that enforces fair gameplay by verifying client mods and resource packs on join, instantly blocking players with blacklisted or unauthorized content.
body:
![Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Header.webp)

![Over](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Description.webp)
The **Saros Mod Checker** is a server-side mod that verifies client mods and resource packs when players join your server. It checks all installed mods and active resource packs against a configurable blacklist, automatically disconnecting players who have forbidden content installed.

![Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Features.webp)
- **Mod Verification** 🔍  
  - Automatically scans all client mods when players join the server.
  
- **Resource Pack Checking** 📦  
  - Validates active resource packs alongside mods for complete content verification.

- **SHA-256 Hash Verification** 🔐  
  - Uses secure SHA-256 hashing to identify mods and resource packs by their exact content.

- **Configurable Blacklist** ⚙️  
  - Easy-to-edit JSON configuration file to manage blacklisted mod names and hashes.

- **Automatic Mod List Export** 📋  
  - Exports the server's mod list to `modlist.md` on server startup.

- **Instant Kick Protection** 🛡️  
  - Players with blacklisted mods or resource packs are immediately disconnected with a clear message.

![Usage](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Usage.webp)
- **Server Setup**: Install the mod on your server - it will automatically create a default blacklist config.
- **Client Requirement**: Players must have Saros Mod Checker installed to join the server.
- **Blacklist Configuration**: Edit `config/sarosmodchecker-blacklist.json` to add mod names or SHA-256 hashes.
- **Verification Process**: When a player joins, their mods and resource packs are automatically verified.

![commands](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Commands.webp)
- `/checkclientmods <player>`: View all mods and resource packs installed on a connected player's client. (OP Level 2 required)

![versions](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/SAROS_MOD_CHECKER/MP_SAROS_MOD_CHECKER_Versions.webp)
### Currently Supported
